name: Amcrest-PTZ-Bridge
description: Expose the local DVRIP pan and tilt controls of an Amcrest SmartHome camera as an ONVIF PTZ service for Frigate. Video and audio remain direct between the camera and Frigate; this bridge handles movement commands only. Frigate configuration (add this block to the existing camera definition): cameras: patio_camera: # Existing ffmpeg, detect, objects, zones, and other settings stay here. # Add this block to this existing camera definition. onvif: host: 192.0.2.10 # Replace with the Unraid server LAN address. port: 18880 # Match this bridge instance's ONVIF host port. user: "" password: ""

paths.name: Camera password secret file
paths.description: Optional host file containing only the camera password. When used, choose the host file here and set Camera password file to /run/secrets/camera_password. Leave blank to use Camera password.

ports.name: ONVIF host port
ports.description: Port Frigate uses to reach this camera's ONVIF PTZ facade. Use a unique host port for each installed camera.

variables.name: Camera name
variables.description: Friendly name reported by the ONVIF service.

variables.name: Camera IP or hostname
variables.description: LAN address of the Amcrest camera, for example 192.0.2.25 (replace this documentation-only address).

variables.name: Camera username
variables.description: Local camera account with PTZ permission.

variables.name: Camera password
variables.description: Local camera password. Leave blank when using the optional secret-file settings below. This is masked in the form but remains available to Docker as an environment value.

variables.name: Camera password file
variables.description: Optional container path for the mounted password file. Set to /run/secrets/camera_password when using Camera password secret file; otherwise leave blank.

variables.name: Camera DVRIP port
variables.description: Local Dahua DVRIP service port. Most Amcrest SmartHome cameras use 37777.

variables.name: Camera model
variables.description: Model label reported to ONVIF clients.

variables.name: Camera channel
variables.description: DVRIP camera channel. Standalone cameras normally use channel 0.

variables.name: Maximum move time
variables.description: Fail-safe maximum movement duration in seconds if an ONVIF Stop request is lost.

variables.name: Allowed clients
variables.description: Optional comma-separated IP/CIDR allowlist. Leave empty to accept any client that can reach the published LAN port. Docker NAT may present clients as a 172.16.0.0/12 gateway address.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: Python log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.
